title: umbracoCli manifest extension
description: A package manifest extension that declares what the package changes about the umbraco CLI's commands. See docs/extensions.md.

alias.description: Unique across the site. Use the package id plus ".Cli".

meta.description: The capabilities this package declares. The CLI ignores keys it does not know.

dictionaryValueFormat.description: The format this site stores dictionary translations in.

commandTool.description: The .NET tool that adds this package's own commands. See docs/extension-commands.md.

noun.description: The command noun: the tool installs umbraco-<noun>.

package.description: The tool's NuGet package id, for dotnet tool install.
